title: EVGA 1080 Ti
description: A reminder of a better era for PC hardware. The 1080 Ti was The Golden Age of components.

title: EVGA 2080 Ti
description: The first generation of RTX. A new era of graphics technology, with the 80-tier cards carrying a serious premium. We thought prices could only get better from here.

title: Gigabyte 3080 Ti
description: The beginning of a difficult period for PC hardware pricing. Mining demand and the COVID supply shortages pushed GPU prices to new heights.

title: PNY 4080 Ti
description: The fourth generation of RTX. Prices showed little sign of returning to normal, despite hopes that the market would eventually settle.

title: ASUS 5080 ProArt
description: The new reality of graphics cards. High pricing has become the norm with fake frames increasingly part of the story. The ProArt edition atleast makes it look pertty

title: NVIDIA 5090
description: NVIDIA flagship consumer graphics card. The top of the RTX 50 Series, with a price tag to match. Expensive, difficult to find, and firmly in a league of its own.
